description: Author-created frozen suite; no claim of external unseen validation.

questions.question: How many securities are classified as Bond? Return just the count.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM securities WHERE asset_type='Bond'

questions.question: List the names of Passive portfolios, alphabetically.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT portfolio_name FROM portfolios WHERE status='Passive' ORDER BY portfolio_name

questions.question: What is the total AUM across all portfolios? Return one value.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT SUM(total_aum) FROM portfolios

questions.question: List portfolio_name and total_aum for Low risk portfolios, highest AUM first.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT portfolio_name,total_aum FROM portfolios WHERE target_risk_level='Low' ORDER BY total_aum DESC

questions.question: Count portfolios by status. Return status and count, sorted by status.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT status,COUNT(*) FROM portfolios GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

questions.question: Which stock symbols trade on NYSE? Return symbols alphabetically.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT symbol FROM securities WHERE exchange='NYSE' AND asset_type='Stock' ORDER BY symbol

questions.question: Return the minimum and maximum current_price across all securities.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT MIN(current_price),MAX(current_price) FROM securities

questions.question: How many distinct countries are represented by securities? Return just the count.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country) FROM securities

questions.question: Return benchmark_name for Equity benchmarks in alphabetical order.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT benchmark_name FROM benchmarks WHERE benchmark_type='Equity' ORDER BY benchmark_name

questions.question: Return symbol and maturity_date for bonds maturing before 2026-01-01, oldest maturity first.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT symbol,maturity_date FROM securities WHERE asset_type='Bond' AND maturity_date<'2026-01-01' ORDER BY maturity_date

questions.question: List Financials sector stock symbols and company names, alphabetically by symbol.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT s.symbol,s.company_name FROM securities s JOIN sectors c USING(sector_id) WHERE c.sector_name='Financials' AND s.asset_type='Stock' ORDER BY s.symbol

questions.question: Return portfolio_name and number of holdings for each portfolio, alphabetically by portfolio_name.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT p.portfolio_name,COUNT(h.holding_id) FROM portfolios p LEFT JOIN holdings h USING(portfolio_id) GROUP BY p.portfolio_id ORDER BY p.portfolio_name

questions.question: Return portfolio_name for portfolios holding AAPL, alphabetically.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT p.portfolio_name FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h USING(portfolio_id) JOIN securities s USING(security_id) WHERE s.symbol='AAPL' ORDER BY p.portfolio_name

questions.question: Return sector_name and count of Stock securities per represented sector, alphabetically by sector.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT c.sector_name,COUNT(*) FROM securities s JOIN sectors c USING(sector_id) WHERE s.asset_type='Stock' GROUP BY c.sector_id ORDER BY c.sector_name

questions.question: List names of sectors with no securities, alphabetically.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT c.sector_name FROM sectors c LEFT JOIN securities s USING(sector_id) WHERE s.security_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.sector_name

questions.question: Return transaction_type and total fees per transaction type, sorted by transaction_type.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT transaction_type,SUM(fees) FROM transactions GROUP BY transaction_type ORDER BY transaction_type

questions.question: What is total BUY notional (quantity times price) across transactions? Return one value, excluding fees.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT SUM(quantity*price) FROM transactions WHERE transaction_type='BUY'

questions.question: Return the total fees for Growth Equity Fund transactions as one value.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT SUM(t.fees) FROM transactions t JOIN portfolios p USING(portfolio_id) WHERE p.portfolio_name='Growth Equity Fund'

questions.question: What is the latest historical price date in the dataset? Return one value.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT MAX(price_date) FROM historical_prices

questions.question: Return price_date and close_price for AAPL historical prices, oldest first.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT h.price_date,h.close_price FROM historical_prices h JOIN securities s USING(security_id) WHERE s.symbol='AAPL' ORDER BY h.price_date

questions.question: Calculate current market value of all Balanced Portfolio holdings as one value using quantity times current price.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT SUM(h.quantity*s.current_price) FROM holdings h JOIN securities s USING(security_id) JOIN portfolios p USING(portfolio_id) WHERE p.portfolio_name='Balanced Portfolio'

questions.question: What is total cost_basis of Conservative Income Fund? Return one value.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT SUM(h.cost_basis) FROM holdings h JOIN portfolios p USING(portfolio_id) WHERE p.portfolio_name='Conservative Income Fund'

questions.question: Return portfolio_name and summed current_weight for every portfolio, alphabetically by name.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT p.portfolio_name,SUM(h.current_weight) FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h USING(portfolio_id) GROUP BY p.portfolio_id ORDER BY p.portfolio_name

questions.question: Return asset_type and total current_weight in Balanced Portfolio, sorted by asset_type.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT s.asset_type,SUM(h.current_weight) FROM holdings h JOIN securities s USING(security_id) JOIN portfolios p USING(portfolio_id) WHERE p.portfolio_name='Balanced Portfolio' GROUP BY s.asset_type ORDER BY s.asset_type

questions.question: Return symbol and market value (quantity times current_price) of the three largest Tech Innovation Fund positions by market value, descending.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT s.symbol,h.quantity*s.current_price AS market_value FROM holdings h JOIN securities s USING(security_id) JOIN portfolios p USING(portfolio_id) WHERE p.portfolio_name='Tech Innovation Fund' ORDER BY market_value DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: Return symbol and unrealized gain (quantity times current_price minus cost_basis) for Growth Equity Fund holdings, sorted by symbol.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT s.symbol,h.quantity*s.current_price-h.cost_basis FROM holdings h JOIN securities s USING(security_id) JOIN portfolios p USING(portfolio_id) WHERE p.portfolio_name='Growth Equity Fund' ORDER BY s.symbol

questions.question: Return performance_date and nav for Balanced Portfolio performance history, oldest first.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT f.performance_date,f.nav FROM portfolio_performance f JOIN portfolios p USING(portfolio_id) WHERE p.portfolio_name='Balanced Portfolio' ORDER BY f.performance_date

questions.question: Return portfolio_name and beta for risk metrics on 2023-10-09, alphabetically by name.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT p.portfolio_name,r.beta FROM risk_metrics r JOIN portfolios p USING(portfolio_id) WHERE r.calculation_date='2023-10-09' ORDER BY p.portfolio_name

questions.question: Return portfolio_name for portfolios with only bonds and at least one holding, alphabetically.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT p.portfolio_name FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h USING(portfolio_id) JOIN securities s USING(security_id) GROUP BY p.portfolio_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN s.asset_type='Stock' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0 ORDER BY p.portfolio_name

questions.question: Return portfolio_name and total bond market value for portfolios holding bonds, highest value first.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT p.portfolio_name,SUM(h.quantity*s.current_price) AS bond_value FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h USING(portfolio_id) JOIN securities s USING(security_id) WHERE s.asset_type='Bond' GROUP BY p.portfolio_id ORDER BY bond_value DESC

questions.question: How many portfolios own at least one Healthcare security? Return one count.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT h.portfolio_id) FROM holdings h JOIN securities s USING(security_id) JOIN sectors c USING(sector_id) WHERE c.sector_name='Healthcare'

questions.question: Return portfolio_name and number of distinct Stock sectors for each portfolio with stocks, alphabetically.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT p.portfolio_name,COUNT(DISTINCT s.sector_id) FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h USING(portfolio_id) JOIN securities s USING(security_id) WHERE s.asset_type='Stock' GROUP BY p.portfolio_id ORDER BY p.portfolio_name

questions.question: Return the count of historical price records for each symbol, sorted by symbol; columns symbol and count.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT s.symbol,COUNT(*) FROM securities s JOIN historical_prices h USING(security_id) GROUP BY s.security_id ORDER BY s.symbol

questions.question: What is the average AUM of Medium risk portfolios? Return a single value.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT AVG(total_aum) FROM portfolios WHERE target_risk_level='Medium'
